item.title: HSBC SVNS action set to heat up in Perth
item.description: The HSBC SVNS spotlight turns to Perth this week as the world’s best sevens sides arrive in Western Australia. Australia’s women return to familiar turf, looking to defend their Perth crown and contend for the top spot on the SVNS league standings.

item.title: Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 schedule revealed with first tickets available from 18 February
item.description: The match schedule and ticket prices for Men’s Rugby World Cup Australia 2027 have been revealed, confirming dates, venues, and kick-off times for all 52 tournament matches.

item.title: How HSBC SVNS rugby stars look to beat jet lag
item.description: Quick tournament turnarounds and long travel distances mean jet lag is a genuine fitness issue for players on the HSBC SVNS circuit. But how do they deal with it?

item.title: How new-look HSBC SVNS set-up has changed the game
item.description: Three rounds into the new-format HSBC SVNS season, Rupert Cox finds out what the changes mean for the teams on the field, and the coaches at pitchside

item.title: STRENGTH STYLED: HSBC SVNS introduces Hard as Nails ahead of Perth weekend
item.description: HSBC SVNS kicks off on Saturday, 7 February with World Rugby marking the occasion with the launch of 'Hard as Nails'. Celebrating style, strength and self-expression, players are set to showcase bespoke nail polish alongside the athleticism, resilience and physicality on display throughout the tournament.

item.title: Charlton Kerr and the art of life and rugby maintenance
item.description: Great Britain’s philosophical men’s sevens captain explains his approach to international rugby and full-time work with former teammate Tom Mitchell

item.title: New Zealand’s HSBC SVNS heroes straight outta Southland
item.description: Winners in Dubai, and third in Singapore, the All Blacks Sevens are building a squad for the future after a nightmare 2025, writes Rikki Swannell

item.title: Watch LIVE international sevens and 15s rugby on RugbyPass TV this February
item.description: RugbyPass TV (online and FAST) is the home of world-class rugby this February, delivering a blockbuster line-up of LIVE international sevens and 15s, available FREE to fans in select territories.

item.title: HSBC SVNS: Dominant Australia and New Zealand on course for Perth final
item.description: New Zealand and Australia powered into the semi-finals of the HSBC SVNS at HBF Park with pool perfect outings on a scorching opening day in Western Australia.

item.title: HSBC SVNS: Australia survive Great Britain scare and Fiji claim ‘pool of death’ top spot on thrilling day in Perth
item.description: Hosts and two-time finalists Australia finished day one at HBF Park at the top of their pool in their home tournament for the first time ever — but they had to do it the hard way, as Great Britain threatened a major shock in the final match of the day.
